Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_11752",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libyara/re_grammar.y","function":"yyparse",
    "line":313,"var":"$$","code":"$$ = yr_re_node_create(RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY); $$->greedy = false;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input regex .{0,201}? creates a non-greedy RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY node with end=201 > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD(200), triggering the chaining split path"},
   {"step":2,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration",
    "line":604,"var":"re_ast","code":"result = yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point(re_ast, &re_ast, &remainder_re_ast, &min_gap, &max_gap);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"First call to split finds the range-any node as the first child of CONCAT, splits the AST and creates remainder_re_ast with a dangling children_head pointer"},
   {"step":3,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":497,"var":"concat->children_head","code":"concat->children_head = re_ast->root_node->children_head;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"When the chaining-point node IS the first child (children_head), concat->children_head is set to the node that will be destroyed on line 514, creating a dangling pointer"},
   {"step":4,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":514,"var":"child","code":"yr_re_node_destroy(child);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"The chaining point node is freed, but concat->children_head still references it"},
   {"step":5,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration",
    "line":642,"var":"remainder_re_ast","code":"result = yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point(remainder_re_ast, &re_ast, &remainder_re_ast, &min_gap, &max_gap);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Second call passes the corrupted remainder_re_ast whose root_node->children_head is dangling"},
   {"step":6,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":478,"var":"child","code":"child = re_ast->root_node->children_head;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Loads the dangling pointer from concat->children_head into local variable child"},
   {"step":7,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
    "line":480,"var":"child->greedy","code":"if (!child->greedy && child->type == RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY && ...)",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Heap-use-after-free READ 4 bytes: dereferences the freed node to read child->greedy and child->type fields"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"libyara/re_grammar.y","function":"yyparse",
     "line":313,"operands":["RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY node with greedy=false, end=201"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
     "line":497,"operands":["concat->children_head","child"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"concat->children_head","right":"child"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
     "line":480,"operands":["child->greedy","child"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"child","right":"NULL"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libyara/re_grammar.y","function":"yyparse",
       "line":313,"operands":["RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY"]},
      "to":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
       "line":497,"operands":["concat->children_head"]},
      "type":"data","via":["re_ast->root_node->children_head"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
       "line":514,"operands":["child"]},
      "to":{"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point",
       "line":480,"operands":["child->greedy"]},
      "type":"data","via":["concat->children_head","remainder_re_ast->root_node->children_head"]}
   ]
 }}
